import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

lemma n_le_pow_three_halves (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : (n : ℝ) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
  induction' hn using Nat.le_induction with k hk IH
  · norm_num
  · have h_k_ge_2 : (k : ℝ) ≥ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have h_IH : (k : ℝ) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k := IH
    calc
      (k + 1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) / 2 := by
        have : (k : ℝ) / 2 ≥ 1 := by linarith
        linarith
      _ = (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) := by ring
      _ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
        gcongr
        <;> assumption
      _ = (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        ring_nf

theorem algebra_ineq_nto1onlt2m1on
  (n : ℕ) :
  (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / n : ℝ) ≤ 2 - 1 / n := by
  rcases n with (_ | _ | n) <;> simp_all [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero]
  · norm_num
  · norm_num
  · have h_n_ge_2 : (n + 2 : ℕ) ≥ 2 := by linarith
    have h_main : (n + 2 : ℝ) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 2) := by
      apply n_le_pow_three_halves
      exact_mod_cast h_n_ge_2
    
    have h_rpow : (n + 2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / (n + 2 : ℝ)) ≤ 3 / 2 := by
      have h_pos : 0 < (n + 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
      have h_base_pos : 0 < (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
      calc
        (n + 2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / (n + 2 : ℝ)) 
          ≤ ((3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 2)) ^ (1 / (n + 2 : ℝ)) := by
            gcongr
            <;> assumption
        _ = ((3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((n + 2 : ℝ))) ^ (1 / (n + 2 : ℝ)) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
        _ = (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (((n + 2 : ℝ)) * (1 / (n + 2 : ℝ))) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_mul h_base_pos] <;> positivity
        _ = (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
          field_simp
        _ = 3 / 2 := by norm_num
    
    have h_rhs : (3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 - 1 / (n + 2 : ℝ) := by
      have h_n_ge_2_real : (n + 2 : ℝ) ≥ 2 := by exact_mod_cast h_n_ge_2
      field_simp
      rw [mul_comm]
      linarith
    
    calc
      (n + 2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / (n + 2 : ℝ)) ≤ 3 / 2 := h_rpow
      _ ≤ 2 - 1 / (n + 2 : ℝ) := h_rhs
